target_customer: Parents and grandparents (families with young children, often separated by distance) who use a free consumer video calling app
problem: Young children cannot sit through a normal video call with distant relatives, so the call is short and awkward. Together adds games, books and stories inside the call to keep kids engaged.
business_model: Free consumer app with interactive content; no revenue model found in sources
product_category: Consumer video calling app for kids and families

founders.name: Enrique Rodriguez Chamussy
founders.background_notes: A Kinzoo interview says he has built apps since the earliest days of the app industry and that Together was his first kids app. The YC page lists no education or employers. YC page says he later works on MovePlay, a camera based kids activity app.

technical_complexity.rationale: A WebRTC style video calling app with embedded games and a book library is standard consumer app engineering that one developer could build. Child safety features add some work but nothing research grade.

defensibility.rationale: Games and books layered on video calls are easy to copy, and general purpose callers such as FaceTime and Zoom could add similar features. No network effect or exclusive content is documented.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent copied it in the sources seen. A niche kids app company, Kinzoo, acquired it in late 2022 and kept the Together name for the app.

market_need_then: The 2020 pandemic sharply raised demand for video calls between kids and distant relatives. The founder says the idea came from his own young daughters losing focus on calls with their grandparents.

branding.domain_note: Company site is togethervideoapp.com, so the exact word domain was not obtained. The site returned an error when fetched.

identity.voice_and_tone: Warm and family oriented per Kinzoo copy about grandparents and grandkids

brand_strength.rationale: The name is a common word, shared by many other apps, and no sources show press, community or merch about the brand itself. App Store listing still carries the Together name under Kinzoo.

outcome_analysis: Together was a one person consumer app that rode the 2020 pandemic surge in family video calling and joined YC in Summer 2020. It did not raise institutional money that sources can verify, and a family focused kids company, Kinzoo, absorbed it in late 2022 as the pandemic tailwind faded. The result looks like a small soft landing rather than a venture scale outcome. Deal terms are not public.
notes: Company website fetch failed with a 503, so treat the site as unreachable at time of research. Acquisition date conflicts: one Kinzoo post is dated December 12, 2022 per a search summary while another Kinzoo announcement is described as February 2023; recorded as 2022-12 per the YC founder bio saying 2022. Aggregators list a seed of about 125 to 130 thousand dollars with no named investors; unverified and not recorded as a round. Competitor list is empty because no dated source near mid 2020 was found. Confidence low because founder history and funding are unsourced. Completeness pass: the seed round rests on a single database (CB Insights, total $130K, no date); another aggregator gives $125K dated 2020-08-24. A CB Insights comparison page shows $6.97M total raised, which conflicts and is not recorded. Kinzoo announced the acquisition on 2023-02-08 (company blog).
